# Hendrickson Law

> St. Louis-based medical malpractice law firm specializing in surgical errors, birth injuries, orthopedic negligence, and nursing home abuse with 30+ years of attorney experience.

Hendrickson Law is a dedicated medical malpractice practice led by Todd N. Hendrickson, serving the St. Louis and Missouri regions. The firm handles complex cases including surgical malpractice, diagnostic errors, orthopedic injuries, and elder care negligence.
